title: ENDEX: Stillwater Creek Interceptor, 13:45

fields.resolution: ENDEX. EXERCISE, NOT A SAFETY EVALUATION OF ANY REAL STRUCTURE. It is 13:45 on Wednesday, April 14, 2027. The gas at 16+00 is controlled, the trench inside the 50-foot tape is being held as an investigation scene, and excavation is stopped across the job with no written release signed. This ends the exercise.
finalState: Valley Gas squeezed off and purged the service. The print shop and the apartment house have no gas until the tee arrives on Monday.
The trench box, the shoring, the soil logs, form LC-F-22 and the CG-3 record are kept as found for the OSHA compliance officer, who is due at 15:00.
The print shop is posted RESTRICTED USE until the Engineer of Record gives a written assessment. CG-3 read 0.28 in at 12:55, above the 0.25 in action level, and is still logged every 15 minutes.
The families are with the Larkspur team and the trauma center chaplain. Larkspur has not released any name.
The OSHA, Ohio811 (DR-27-0414-0397), insurer (CL-27-044817) and owner notifications are recorded in the call log.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Players, put down your materials, phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash: what went well, what did not, and what changes before the next shift.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: each role names three things that went well and three things that broke, then we go through the timeline from 10:12 to 13:45.
hotWashQuestions: Who stopped work, when, and under whose authority? Who would have to agree before anyone digs again at 17+50 to 18+50, and why did the release stay unsigned?
When did Larkspur first learn of the helper's in-patient admission and of the fatality? Did the 24-hour and 8-hour OSHA reports run from those times?
How was the wife of the pipe layer told, by whom, and how did we keep the name from reaching her through Facebook or Channel 9 first?
Did the Project Executive speak with one voice to Channel 9, the Dayton Ledger and the District PIO? What did we say about the gas marking before the facts were verified?

Why did the service at 16+00 show on the Valley Gas drawing but not on the field marks for locate ticket 2711-4482? What do we change in pre-dig checks and in the competent person's response to seepage after rain?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect the incident log, the headcount sheets, the unsigned restart release and any draft statements before the break. Cover the laborer foreman's push to use the standby excavator and the request to add a line to LC-F-22 after the fact, and remind the room that records are never altered.
